identity.claim_ceiling: Only STF2/STF3/null-cone algebra; no generic root isolation, numerical conversion, product law or statistical admission

semantics.exact_statement: For arbitrary real Cartesian 3-vectors u,v,w and amplitude A verify the three exact identities in target. Symmetric tensors use full component multiplicity. Rank2 S=(u tensor v+v tensor u)/2; Q=A*(S-delta*(u dot v)/3). Rank3 S=sym(u tensor v tensor w), b=( (u dot v)*w+(u dot w)*v+(v dot w)*u )/3; O=A*(S-(delta_ij*b_k+delta_ik*b_j+delta_jk*b_i)/5). Unit-vector normalization is a separate numerical interface condition, not needed for these identities.

frame_signature_units_conventions.units: A in K for unit input vectors

assumptions: Ordinary polynomial algebra over real and complex fields.
Existence/uniqueness of full MV for harmonic tensors is the named Katz-Weeks theorem, not re-proven by this finite algebra contract.
exclusions: generic root isolation and uniqueness proof

target.canonical_form: Every specified polynomial identity reduces identically to zero
forbidden_shortcuts: No numeric fixtures alone for arbitrary vectors
No sibling derivations/results before own submission
Incomplete proof is unresolved, not a weaker PASS

obligation_details.O4_STF2_trace_sign_permutation: Q is symmetric, sum_i Q_ii=0; swapping u,v leaves Q invariant; replacing (A,u) by (-A,-u) leaves Q invariant; A=0 gives zero.
obligation_details.O4_STF3_trace_sign_permutation: O is symmetric in indices and under arbitrary permutations of u,v,w; sum_i O_iik=0 for k=1,2,3; replacing (A,u) by (-A,-u) leaves O invariant; A=0 gives zero.
obligation_details.O4_null_cone_and_trace_removal: n(z)=(1-z^2,i*(1+z^2),2z) has n dot n=0; contracting Q with n^2 equals A*(u dot n)*(v dot n), and contracting O with n^3 equals A*(u dot n)*(v dot n)*(w dot n). Polynomial identities over complex z, no Hermitian conjugation in the bilinear dot.
